verdict.rationale: An online government filing portal with user accounts (PBS accounts) could plausibly offer data-retention or deletion controls, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only business-record lifecycle actions such as dissolving entities, terminating name reservations and terminating UCC financing statements. These are adjacent legal-filing features, not user control over how long the service retains personal or account data or how it is deleted, and no retention policy or deletion mechanism is documented.
